- |P| = 10 (10 slices have pepperoni)
- |M| = 10 (10 slices have mushrooms)
- Every slice has at least one topping, so the total number of slices is 18.  
Using the inclusion‑exclusion principle:
\[
|P \cup M| = |P| + |M| - |P \cap M|
\]

\[
18 = 10 + 10 - |P \cap M|
\]

\[
|P \cap M| = 20 - 18 = 2
\]
Thus, 2 slices have both pepperoni and mushrooms.
